attributes.title: When Internal Signals Mislead: Sensing and Preference in Artificial Homeostasis
attributes.description:
Author: Jonathan D Faeth. Affiliation: Independent Researcher.

This simulation study tests whether coupled selective sensing and assumed likelihood precision differ from preference reweighting in robustness to misleading internal signals. In the AffectWorld platform, three agent configurations will be evaluated under clean, positively biased, and symmetric-perturbation conditions across 12 fixed layouts and 64 new seeds (6,912 episodes). The primary outcome is a 40-step resource-regulation loss including a terminal-failure penalty. The primary estimand is the seed-paired difference between coupled and preference agents in bias-minus-clean loss, with a two-sided 95% Student-t interval. Earlier exploratory simulations informed the design and are excluded from confirmation. This is an empirical extension of prior artificial-homeostasis research; subjective experience and consciousness are not measured.

305-2.value: Does coupled selective sensing and assumed likelihood precision differ from preference reweighting in robustness to misleading internal signals in a simulated homeostatic agent? The primary null hypothesis is that the mean paired difference-in-differences in regulation loss, (coupled bias minus coupled clean) minus (preference bias minus preference clean), averaged equally across 12 fixed layouts and then over 64 seeds, is zero. The alternative is two-sided. Positive values favor preference on this robustness contrast. We estimate this contrast and its 95% Student-t confidence interval. This is a replication/extension of Grimbly et al. (2026), Interoceptive Attention as Dynamic Homeostatic Prioritization in a Foraging Agent, https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.04232. It addresses an upstream open comparison, not a claim to invent artificial homeostasis or demonstrate consciousness. See the attached protocol for the complete prespecified plan.

305-8.value: Parametric, agent-environment simulation using the AffectWorld source at commit 2657a982c5ae59a0f0fa9cdf941f82a71eba3cd9 (https://github.com/sgrimbly/attention-aif-sab2026-snapshot). Cross all 12 original layouts (six easy, three medium, three far), three agents (uniform reference, coupled selective sensing and likelihood precision, preference-only reweighting), and three sensor conditions (clean, positive bias, symmetric perturbation). Use known resource maps, two-step planning, no online resource-model learning, fresh initial beliefs and physiology, and a 40-step horizon. Fatigue accumulation is disabled, with the fourth modality retained. Attended correctness is 0.90 with total probability budget 2.6; selected preference weight is 2.0 and the other weights 2/3. These budgets have different units and do not imply equal behavioral strength. No agent has oracle body-state access. At t=5 through 14, thirst readings 1–4 receive +1 (bias), equiprobable +/-1 (symmetric), or zero (clean). Readings 0 or 5, and other times, are unchanged. No clipping. Paired pre-generated random streams include sham draws. Closed-loop eligibility and actual dose may differ across agents; log exposure without adjusting the primary contrast for it. The attached protocol and source archive specify all settings. Exploratory development informed these choices; no reserved main-study seeds have been run.

305-13.value: Fully factorial: 12 fixed layouts x 3 agents x 3 sensor conditions = 108 cells per seed. Run all cells for each of 64 new seeds, 10000–10063 inclusive: 6,912 episodes. Seeds are the independent replication units; layouts are a fixed bank, equally weighted. Do not exclude hard or unfavorable layouts. No significance-based early stopping, replacement of seeds, or sample extension.

305-16.value: Primary outcome: regulation loss over 40 steps. At each executed step after the action, average (1 - nutrient/15) and (1 - hydration/15); assign loss 1 to each remaining step after terminal failure, then average all 40 values. Lower is better. For each seed and layout compute (coupled bias loss - coupled clean loss) - (preference bias loss - preference clean loss). Average equally across the 12 fixed layouts within seed, then across 64 seeds. This targets the total response to the intervention rule over simulation randomness on this fixed layout bank; it is not a generalization to all possible environments. Positive values favor preference; negative values favor coupled. Secondary descriptive outcomes are survival through 40 steps, restricted time to failure, observed-step resource deficits, body-estimation error, and intervention exposure. Secondary regulation-loss contrasts are clean selective arms minus uniform, noise minus clean within each arm, and bias minus noise within each arm. Prespecified scoring sensitivity holds terminal observed deficit constant for remaining steps, instead of loss 1. Neither score measures subjective feeling or consciousness.

305-19.value: Compare uniform reference, coupled selective sensing plus assumed likelihood precision, and preference-only reweighting. All use the same external-need selector, action space, virtual body, and planner. Selective effects are disabled for uniform. Keep attended correctness 0.90 under total correctness-probability budget 2.6, and selected preference weight 2.0 with other weights 2/3. These candidate settings were examined during exploratory development; they are not claimed to match behavioral strength. Known resource maps and two-step planning were chosen after one-step pilots showed a performance floor. No online resource-model learning; reset beliefs and physiology each episode. The pinned source and attached five executable scripts define remaining defaults and overrides, with dependencies and SHA256 manifest in preregistration-package.zip. Extract complete per-step states, observations, actions/policy information, sensor eligibility and increments, and episode summaries. For the primary contrast compute the mean of the 64 seed-level paired contrasts and a two-sided 95% Student-t interval (df=63), without treating steps or layouts as independent replicates. This interval assumes independent seed replicates and an adequate approximation for their mean. Secondary loss contrasts use the same within-seed/layout pairing and across-seed t intervals, are descriptive, and do not support additional unadjusted confirmatory discoveries. No post-treatment exposure adjustment. Audit record identities, hashes, completeness and scores. Report no complete primary analysis if any required cells are missing. Physiological failure remains a valid outcome; software errors are logged separately. Identical infrastructure retries use the same seed/configuration and retain attempts logs. A defect changing scientific behavior requires stopping and a documented public amendment, without silently mixing versions.

305-25.value: Let d_s be the primary paired contrast averaged equally across 12 layouts for seed s. Report mean(d_s), all 64 seed values, MCSE = sample SD(d_s)/sqrt(64), and mean(d_s) +/- t_(0.975,63)*MCSE. This quantifies simulation randomness for the fixed layout bank. Layouts and time steps are not independent sample units. Secondary regulation-loss contrasts use the same seed-level aggregation and descriptive intervals. The planned 64 repetitions per cell balance precision scenarios and computational constraints. The four-seed exploratory pilot SD was approximately 0.0965, giving a nominal 95% interval halfwidth of about 0.024 at n=64; twice that SD gives about 0.048, and SD=0.30 gives about 0.075. The pilot used only two layouts and a different intervention, so these are uncertain scenarios, not guaranteed power. See sample-size-planning.json in the archive and protocol.md.

305-30.value: Exactly 64 repetitions per condition, using seeds 10000–10063, for 6,912 episodes total. No significance-based stopping, extension, or seed replacement. Physiological terminal failure is a valid outcome, not non-convergence, and receives the prespecified loss penalty. Log software exceptions and nonfinite values separately; stop and investigate instead of imputing or dropping them. Infrastructure retries use identical seeds and configuration and retain every attempt log. Checkpoints allow resumption of predetermined missing cases. No complete primary analysis is reported until all required cells are valid and audited. No conditions are removed based on failure rate. A behavior-changing code fix requires a public amendment and explicit separation of versions.

305-32.value: Lower regulation loss is better. Positive primary contrast favors preference over coupled sensing/precision for the bias-minus-clean response; negative favors coupled. A provisional practical difference is 0.05 loss units, a study-design convention with no biological validation. An interval crossing zero is not evidence of equivalence. No claim about subjective feeling or consciousness follows from these measures. Report all layouts and tiers, including failures, and the terminal-hold scoring sensitivity alongside the primary death-penalized score. No additional regression model or confirmatory secondary tests are planned.

305-35.value: Python 3.14.0; inferactively-pymdp 1.0.4; numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1; pandas 3.0.6; jax/jaxlib 0.11.0; equinox 0.13.8. Full package versions appear in dependencies.json and requirements.txt in the attached archive. AffectWorld source is pinned to commit 2657a982c5ae59a0f0fa9cdf941f82a71eba3cd9; the upstream reproduce.py applies its documented pymdp compatibility patch. Executable source SHA256 hashes are recorded in manifest.json and will be recorded again in the run design.

305-37.value: One existing local Windows computer, OS version reported as Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.19045.0, using CPU computation in an isolated Python 3.14.0 environment. No paid cloud or model API is required. The simulated body consists of physiological counters; this study does not measure or control physical hardware temperature, power, or memory. Estimated main-run time is approximately 12–16 hours including overhead, subject to machine load.

305-39.value: Publish the protocol and frozen source/dependency/checksum archive with this registration before launching the confirmatory run. Archive SHA256: 0665ad8d5ebdb226815903ead3dbebb68ca7ee8174605c3c1a1053a2778a573b. Retain complete episode-level and per-step data, configuration, attempt logs, source snapshots, deviations and negative results for later public release with the manuscript. Unique episode identifiers, atomic compressed checkpoints, payload hashes and a completeness audit support reproducibility. Development preflight, synthetic estimator recovery, missing-cell rejection, and interrupted/resumed payload matching passed. The runner requires a registration URL and timestamp, whose authenticity will be independently verified; its format check alone is not proof of registration. The primary analysis and sensitivity are frozen. Additional descriptive secondary reporting may be implemented using the prespecified definitions, with deviations disclosed.

305-41.value: Author: Jonathan D Faeth, Independent Researcher. Exploratory work already exists and informed this design: two 120-episode pilots (0/120 and 66/120 survivors), 14 competence-check episodes, 128 difficulty/sensitivity episodes, six fixed-input diagnostic trajectories, and separate software/control/checkpoint validation. Preserve failed pre-trial implementation attempts and fixes. The exploratory comparisons did not establish a universal winner. No exploratory data enter the confirmatory estimate; reserved seeds 10000–10063 have not been used. AI assistance supported searching, planning, programming, verification, development analysis and drafting; the human author is responsible for reviewing and approving the research. This is a replication/extension of Grimbly et al. (2026), https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.04232, with appropriate upstream attribution and no guaranteed first-of-its-kind claim. No humans, animals or biological substrates are involved; proposed future fungal/slime-mold work is outside this registration. A local draft is not completed preregistration. Wait for the actual registration record before collecting confirmatory data. The attached protocol version 1.0 is the full plan.
